title: typo3-webmcp: the skill at work
description: Search, navigation and forms as typed browser tools. Recorded on a TYPO3 14.3 site in DDEV, in Chrome with WebMCP testing switched on. Nothing was sent. Narrated, with English captions.
alt: Film, 46 seconds: the typo3-webmcp agent skill. Chrome with WebMCP testing lists four browser tools on a TYPO3 14 site. The form tool fills an error report, the consent box stays empty and nothing is sent. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Browser agents now shop and book. Most sites give them nothing to hold.
You ask for search and contact as browser tools.
Chrome now sees four tools: navigation, FAQ search, language and a form helper.
An agent fills the form. The consent box stays empty; a person sends it.
A schema is not consent. People stay in charge.
